name: alrust
source: User-selected 01 / Convergence concept image; manually reconstructed clean vector geometry.

construction.mark: Two filled paths: joined upper/lower routes and a detached rounded central input.
construction.wordmark: Six custom outlined lowercase letterforms and a circular period; no font dependency.
construction.backgrounds: Mark and logo variants have transparent backgrounds; favicon and app icon have opaque rust backgrounds.

clear_space.minimum: 74 mark units on every side outside the asset bounding box (one incoming channel thickness).
clear_space.compact_ui_exception: At 16–32 px, use the padded favicon/app icon composition supplied.

variants.alrust-logo-light.svg: Rust mark and period, charcoal letters.
variants.alrust-logo-dark.svg: Rust mark and period, ivory letters.
variants.favicon.svg: Ivory mark on a rust rounded square, optimized composition for 16–32 px.
variants.alrust-app-icon.svg: 512 px master with the same padded icon composition.

usage: Keep all proportions, channels and the negative-space convergence point intact.
Use the light wordmark on ivory/white and the dark wordmark on charcoal.
Use one mark consistently across website, README, repository avatar and application assets.
Do not add gradients, shadows, outlines or textures to the canonical logo.
The period is part of the supplied primary wordmark; the product name remains alrust.
checks: All glyphs are paths, not SVG text.
No embedded raster images, scripts, external resources, filters or fonts.
All mark variants share the exact same two canonical paths.
project_note: Brand assets do not imply a released or working alrust server.
